abstract: Endodermal sinus tumor, also known as yolk sac tumor (YST), is a malignant germ cell tumor that most frequently occurs in the testis, the ovary, and sacrococcygeal areas in children. YSTs are highly aggressive and because of the early metastatic or invasive pattern, their prognosis has been poor. Treatment methods for YSTs are usually intensive, including multiagent chemotherapy, and have shown to improve patient survival significantly; therefore, it is important to consider the reproductive function of these patients with long-term survival. Herein, we present the case of a 31-year-old female, who was diagnosed with unilateral ovarian YST at the age of 13. The patient was treated with fertility-sparing surgery and postoperative adjuvant chemotherapy. During the subsequent long-term follow-up, she was not only free of disease, but also had a successful, naturally conceived pregnancy at 31 years of age. We, therefore, conclude that YST is a curable disease, and that fertility-preservation surgery and subsequent immediate combination chemotherapy is the treatment of choice.
abstract_ja: 卵黄嚢腫瘍(endodermal sinus tumor、YSTとも呼ばれる)は、小児では主に精巣、卵巣、仙尾部に発生する悪性胚細胞腫瘍である。YSTは非常に侵襲性が高く、早期の転移や浸潤のパターンを示すため、予後は不良であった。YSTの治療は通常、多剤併用化学療法を含む集中的なものであり、患者の生存を著しく改善することが示されている。そのため、長期生存が得られる患者では、生殖機能を考慮することが重要である。今回、13歳時に片側の卵巣卵黄嚢腫瘍と診断された31歳女性の症例を報告する。患者は妊孕性温存手術と術後補助化学療法を受けた。その後の長期フォローアップで、患者は疾患のない状態を保ち、31歳で自然妊娠・出産に至った。したがって、卵黄嚢腫瘍は治癒可能な疾患であり、妊孕性温存手術とそれに続く速やかな併用化学療法が治療の選択肢であると結論づける。
